The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-revert tape), so the entire read is display-only with no validated drawdown edge here — I default to low conviction and few theses.

theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme passing the absolute-trend eligibility gate (eligible=true) AND holding a durability_bar above 0.5, which is the weakest but still positive signal in a market where the gate has no backtested edge. This is a focus lens, not a call that Coal must outperform.
